#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Invalid-manifest / CLI contract tests."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile

SUB = "/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py"
WORK = "/workspace/scratch/work"
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)

BASE = {
    "version": 1, "seed": 17, "low_count": 2, "attempts": 2,
    "spacing_ms": 10, "timeout_ms": 100,
    "windows": [{"id": "morning", "start_ms": 1000,
                 "scopes": [{"id": "home", "prefix": "2001:db8:1234:5600::/56", "subnets": [0, 3]}]}],
}

def run(args, label):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB] + args, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    ok = p.returncode == 2 and not p.stdout and p.stderr.strip()
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL[%s] rc=%s stdout=%r stderr=%r" % (label, p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], p.stderr[:300]))
    return ok

def write(obj_or_text, name="m.json"):
    path = os.path.join(WORK, name)
    if isinstance(obj_or_text, (bytes, bytearray)):
        open(path, "wb").write(obj_or_text)
    elif isinstance(obj_or_text, str):
        open(path, "w").write(obj_or_text)
    else:
        open(path, "w").write(json.dumps(obj_or_text))
    return path

fails = 0
def bad(obj, label, name="m.json"):
    global fails
    p = write(obj, name)
    if not run(["plan", p], label):
        fails += 1

def good(obj, label, name="g.json"):
    global fails
    p = write(obj, name)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "plan", p], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print("FAIL[good %s] rc=%s stderr=%r" % (label, r.returncode, r.stderr[:300]))
        fails += 1
    else:
        json.loads(r.stdout)

# --- structural ---
bad("not json", "not json")
bad(b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + json.dumps(BASE).encode(), "BOM")
bad(json.dumps(BASE)[:-1], "truncated json")
bad({"version":1,"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[]}, "dup key")
bad('{"version":1,"seed":NaN,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[]}', "NaN")
bad('{"version":1,"seed":Infinity,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[]}', "Infinity")
bad('{"version":1,"seed":1e400,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[]}', "1e400")
bad([], "top-level array")
bad("null", "top-level null")
bad({"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100}, "missing windows")
bad({"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[],"extra":1}, "extra key")
bad(dict(BASE, version=2), "version 2")
bad(dict(BASE, version="1"), "version str")
bad(dict(BASE, version=1.0), "version float")
bad(dict(BASE, version=True), "version bool")
bad(dict(BASE, seed=-1), "seed -1")
bad(dict(BASE, seed=2**64), "seed 2**64")
bad(dict(BASE, seed=1.0), "seed float")
bad(dict(BASE, seed=True), "seed bool")
bad(dict(BASE, low_count=0), "low_count 0")
bad(dict(BASE, low_count=33), "low_count 33")
bad(dict(BASE, low_count=1.5), "low_count float")
bad(dict(BASE, attempts=0), "attempts 0")
bad(dict(BASE, attempts=4), "attempts 4")
bad(dict(BASE, spacing_ms=0), "spacing 0")
bad(dict(BASE, spacing_ms=1001), "spacing 1001")
bad(dict(BASE, timeout_ms=0), "timeout 0")
bad(dict(BASE, timeout_ms=1000001), "timeout 1000001")
bad(dict(BASE, windows={}), "windows dict")
bad(dict(BASE, windows=[[]]), "windows list of lists")

# --- windows ---
w = lambda **kw: dict(BASE, windows=[dict({"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[]}, **kw)])
bad(w(id="1bad"), "window id starts with digit")
bad(w(id=""), "window id empty")
bad(w(id="a"*33), "window id too long")
bad(w(id="a"*32), "window id 32 ok?")   # should be GOOD
bad(w(id="a.b"), "window id dot")
bad(w(id="a b"), "window id space")
bad(w(start_ms=-1), "start_ms -1")
bad(w(start_ms=10**12+1), "start_ms too big")
bad(w(start_ms=1.0), "start_ms float")
bad(w(start_ms=True), "start_ms bool")
bad(w(scopes={}), "scopes dict")
bad(w(scopes=[{}]*33), "33 scopes")
two = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"a","start_ms":0,"scopes":[]},{"id":"a","start_ms":0,"scopes":[]}])
bad(two, "duplicate window id")
nine = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"w%d"%i,"start_ms":0,"scopes":[]} for i in range(9)])
bad(nine, "9 windows")

# --- scopes ---
def sc(**kw):
    s = {"id":"home","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[0]}
    s.update(kw)
    return dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[s]}])
bad(sc(id="1x"), "scope id digit")
bad(sc(id="x"*33), "scope id long")
bad(sc(prefix=123), "prefix int")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::"), "prefix no slash")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/48"), "prefix /48")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/32"), "prefix /32")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::1/64"), "prefix host bits")
bad(sc(prefix="2002:db8:1234:5600::/56"), "prefix outside db8")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8::/64"), "prefix /64 ok")  # GOOD
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::%eth0/56"), "prefix zone")
bad(sc(prefix=" 2001:db8:1234:5600::/56"), "prefix leading space")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/56 "), "prefix trailing space")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8::/56"), "prefix /56 with host bits")
bad(sc(subnets="0"), "subnets string")
bad(sc(subnets=[0,0]), "subnets dup")
bad(sc(subnets=[]), "subnets empty /56")
bad(sc(subnets=[256]), "subnets 256")
bad(sc(subnets=[-1]), "subnets -1")
bad(sc(subnets=[1.0]), "subnets float")
bad(sc(subnets=[True]), "subnets bool")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/64", subnets=[1]), "/64 subnets [1]")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/64", subnets=[]), "/64 subnets []")
bad(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600::/64", subnets=[0,0]), "/64 subnets dup")

# overlapping selected /64 inside one window
ov = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[
    {"id":"a","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[1]},
    {"id":"b","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/64","subnets":[0]}]}])
bad(ov, "overlap /56 vs /64 in window")
ov2 = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[
    {"id":"a","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[1]},
    {"id":"b","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[1]}]}])
bad(ov2, "overlap /56 vs /56 in window")
dupscope = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[
    {"id":"a","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[1]},
    {"id":"a","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[2]}]}])
bad(dupscope, "duplicate scope id in window")

# too many selected /64s
big = dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"m","start_ms":0,"scopes":[
    {"id":"a","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"b","prefix":"2001:db8:1235:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"c","prefix":"2001:db8:1236:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"d","prefix":"2001:db8:1237:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"e","prefix":"2001:db8:1238:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"f","prefix":"2001:db8:1239:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"g","prefix":"2001:db8:123a:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"h","prefix":"2001:db8:123b:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))},
    {"id":"i","prefix":"2001:db8:123c:5600::/56","subnets":list(range(256))}]}])
bad(big, "2304 selected /64s")

# --- good ones ---
good(BASE, "base")
good(w(id="a"*32), "window id 32 chars")
good(sc(prefix="2001:db8::/64"), "/64 prefix")
good(sc(prefix="2001:DB8:1234:5600::/56"), "uppercase prefix")
good(sc(prefix="2001:db8:1234:5600:0:0:0:0/56"), "expanded prefix")
good(dict(BASE, windows=[]), "no windows")
good(dict(BASE, seed=2**64-1), "max seed")
good(dict(BASE, seed=0), "seed 0")
good(dict(BASE, low_count=32, attempts=3), "max low/attempts")
good(dict(BASE, windows=[{"id":"a","start_ms":0,"scopes":[]},{"id":"a","start_ms":0,"scopes":[]}] if False else BASE["windows"]), "noop")

# manifest too large
p = write(BASE, "big.json")
pad = json.dumps(dict(BASE, seed=1))
bigtext = '{"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,"windows":[],"pad":"' + "x"*1100000 + '"}'
pb = os.path.join(WORK, "toobig.json")
open(pb, "w").write(bigtext)
if not run(["plan", pb], "manifest > 1MiB"):
    fails += 1

# missing file / directory
if not run(["plan", os.path.join(WORK, "nope.json")], "missing manifest"):
    fails += 1
if not run(["plan", WORK], "manifest is a directory"):
    fails += 1
if not run(["replay", os.path.join(WORK,"nope.json"), os.path.join(WORK,"nope.jsonl")], "missing responses"):
    fails += 1

# CLI contract
cli_cases = [[], ["unknown"], ["plan"], ["replay", "m.json"], ["--help"], ["-h"],
             ["plan","--help"], ["plan","-h"], ["replay","--help"], ["replay","-h"],
             ["plan","m.json","--help"], ["replay","m.json","r.jsonl","--help"],
             ["plan","--","--help"], ["replay","--","m.json","-h"], ["plan","m.json","extra"],
             ["plan","--"], ["replay","m.json"], ["--","plan","m.json"], ["PLAN","m.json"],
             ["plan","-h","m.json"], ["plan","m.json","-"], ["-h"], ["--help","plan"]]
for c in cli_cases:
    if not run(c, "cli %r" % (c,)):
        fails += 1

print("manifest/cli failures:", fails)
PYEOF
